title: Umkhonzi Ka-Allah Ophakamileyo
intro: Uva amazwi angxolayo omntu wamandulo, umkhonzi ka-Allah owaphakanyiswa waya kwisikhundla esingaphezulu kwesiqhelekileyo. Lo mntu wayesaziwa ngomonde ongagungqiyo nokunyaniseka okupheleleyo, waza wathunyelwa kubantu abafulathela umyalezo. Ngubani lo mphefumlo uphakanyisiweyo?
clues: Ndikhethwe ngu-Allah njengomprofeti kwaye ndikhankanywa kwiQuran eNgcwele.
Ndandisaziwa ngokuba nomonde nokunyaniseka, iimpawu ezinconywa nguAllah.
Ndibize abantu bam ukuba banqule uThixo omnye, kodwa abaninzi bandilahlile.
Isikhundla sam saphakanyiswa nguAllah, kwaye ndanikwa isikhundla esiphezulu.
Ndihlala ndikhankanywa kunye nabanye abaprofeti abafana no-Ismail no-Dhul-Kifl.
UAllah uthi ngam: 'Saza samphakamisa samsa kwindawo ephakamileyo.' (19:57)
verse: And We raised him to a high station. (19:57)
